objective: Test logits equivalence at committed positions in deterministic mode.
mathematical_spec: For committed position i, max_j |l_tree(i,j)-l_ref(i,j)| <= atol+rtol*|l_ref(i,j)| under the same precision and backend.
implementation_prompt: Capture target logits at committed positions and compare Tree-Draft versus reference decoding using backend-appropriate absolute and relative tolerances.

objective: Test sampled-output distribution equivalence using categorical goodness-of-fit.
mathematical_spec: For fixed context and categorical probabilities p_j, counts O_j from N Tree-Draft samples satisfy chi2=sum_j (O_j-Np_j)^2/(Np_j), with low-expected-count bins pooled before testing.
implementation_prompt: Build a repeated-sampling statistical test against target categorical probabilities, pool sparse bins, record p-values and effect sizes, and choose N from a documented power target.

objective: Test pairwise sampled-distribution equivalence between Tree-Draft and reference decoding.
mathematical_spec: For empirical token distributions P and Q over the same context, TV(P,Q)=0.5*sum_j |P_j-Q_j|; acceptance requires TV<=epsilon with a confidence interval from resampling.
implementation_prompt: Sample Tree-Draft and reference decoders under matched contexts and seeds-as-replicates, compute total-variation distance with bootstrap confidence intervals, and retain sample counts.

objective: Test acceptance-decision correctness for a single speculative path.
mathematical_spec: For draft probability q(x) and target p(x), accept token x when u<=min(1,p(x)/q(x)); on rejection sample from normalized max(0,p-q).
implementation_prompt: Unit-test the speculative acceptance and residual-distribution rule using hand-computable probability vectors, boundary uniforms, and normalization checks.

objective: Test tree acceptance semantics when multiple candidate branches overlap.
mathematical_spec: At each depth only nodes reachable from the committed prefix are eligible; committed tokens must form one root-to-leaf prefix and no sibling after divergence may be committed.
implementation_prompt: Construct small explicit trees with shared prefixes and divergent siblings, then verify the acceptance routine commits exactly one valid prefix under deterministic random inputs.

objective: Test rejection fallback token selection.
mathematical_spec: After first rejection at context c, fallback distribution r_j=max(0,p_j-q_j)/sum_k max(0,p_k-q_k), with target-distribution fallback used for degenerate numerical cases defined by the algorithm.
implementation_prompt: Exercise rejection paths where residual mass is dense, sparse, nearly zero, or numerically degenerate, checking normalization and selected-token provenance.

objective: Test KV rollback after rejected speculative nodes.
mathematical_spec: After rollback to committed prefix length L, live KV positions and values must equal a reference cache built only from tokens 0..L-1, and no rejected node remains addressable.
implementation_prompt: Create integration tests that force rejection at several tree depths, rollback speculative KV state, and compare live positions plus cache metadata with a clean reference decode.

objective: Test commit correctness after full and partial tree acceptance.
mathematical_spec: If accepted prefix has k tokens, post-commit sequence length increases by k plus any algorithm-defined bonus token, and cache positions map bijectively to the committed sequence positions.
implementation_prompt: Cover zero, partial, and maximal acceptance cases and assert sequence length, committed token order, cache positions, and next-step context are internally consistent.

objective: Unit-test tree metric accounting and invariants.
mathematical_spec: For every run, 0<=accepted_tokens<=proposed_tokens, committed_tokens<=verified_nodes plus defined bonus allowance, and counters equal sums of per-step records.
implementation_prompt: Create counter-level tests with synthetic verification records to prove aggregation invariants for acceptance rate, accepted depth, verified nodes, and committed-token metrics.

objective: Unit-test benchmark quantile and summary statistics.
mathematical_spec: Nearest-rank q_p for sorted n samples is x_{ceil(p*n)} with 1-based indexing; mean, sample variance, min, max, and count must match reference formulas.
implementation_prompt: Test latency and throughput summary helpers on singleton, even, odd, repeated, and extreme-valued datasets with exact expected statistics.

objective: Unit-test benchmark scenario validation and canonicalization.
mathematical_spec: Canonicalize(S1)=Canonicalize(S2) iff all semantically relevant scenario fields are equal after defined normalization; invalid ranges must be rejected.
implementation_prompt: Test accepted and rejected scenario configurations, stable canonical ordering, hash reproducibility, and sensitivity to every semantically relevant field.

objective: Add end-to-end Tree-Draft integration tests across representative tree shapes.
mathematical_spec: For shape set K including depth-1, chain, balanced, wide, and irregular trees, every run must terminate and satisfy sequence, acceptance, and cache invariants.
implementation_prompt: Build integration cases spanning shallow, deep, wide, and irregular tree proposals with deterministic prompts, asserting successful generation and core invariants.

objective: Add batch and concurrent-request integration tests.
mathematical_spec: For requests r in a batch, output and state for r must be observationally equivalent to an isolated run under deterministic settings, modulo documented scheduler ordering.
implementation_prompt: Exercise mixed prompt lengths, output limits, and tree shapes in batched or concurrent execution, checking per-request isolation of tokens, seeds, counters, and KV state.

objective: Add long-context and context-boundary integration tests.
mathematical_spec: For context capacity C, all live positions satisfy 0<=pos<C after any supported shift or eviction operation, and generation behavior follows the configured context policy at boundaries.
implementation_prompt: Test Tree-Draft near context capacity, exact boundary, and post-shift or eviction states with long prompts and multi-node proposals.

objective: Add stop-condition and EOS integration tests.
mathematical_spec: If EOS or a stop condition becomes committed at position i, no token after i may be externally emitted, and speculative descendants after i must not survive commit.
implementation_prompt: Force EOS, token stop sequences, and max-token termination inside proposed trees and verify visible output plus cache commit stop at the correct boundary.

objective: Fuzz tree topology and verification metadata parsers.
mathematical_spec: For arbitrary byte or structured inputs, parser behavior must be total: return valid normalized structure or bounded error; it must never access outside declared buffers or violate parent-before-child invariants.
implementation_prompt: Create a coverage-guided fuzz target for serialized or in-memory tree topology and verification metadata, with strict size bounds and invariant checks.

objective: Property-fuzz acceptance and rollback state transitions.
mathematical_spec: For generated valid trees and decision streams, committed output is always a valid prefix path, rollback removes all noncommitted nodes, and state sizes remain within declared capacities.
implementation_prompt: Generate random small valid trees, acceptance decisions, and rejection points, then assert prefix, rollback, bounds, and counter invariants after each transition.

objective: Run address and undefined-behavior sanitizer coverage for CPU Tree-Draft tests.
mathematical_spec: For the sanitizer test corpus, accepted result requires zero ASan memory errors and zero configured UBSan violations across all executed test cases.
implementation_prompt: Define a CPU sanitizer job that builds the Tree-Draft test surface with ASan and UBSan, runs focused unit, integration, and bounded fuzz regression corpora, and preserves failure logs.

objective: Run thread sanitizer coverage for concurrent Tree-Draft state.
mathematical_spec: For supported TSan builds, acceptance requires zero data-race reports on shared Tree-Draft scheduler, metrics, cache metadata, and request state during concurrent tests.
implementation_prompt: Define a focused TSan job for concurrent requests and shared runtime state with small deterministic workloads that maximize interleaving without excessive CI duration.

objective: Run GPU memory-check coverage for accelerator Tree-Draft kernels.
mathematical_spec: For selected GPU tests, acceptance requires zero invalid global/shared/local memory accesses and zero race reports supported by the configured checker.
implementation_prompt: Specify a bounded accelerator memory-check job over small tree-mask, sampling, KV, and verification workloads, capturing checker diagnostics as CI artifacts.

objective: Define benchmark result artifact schema and provenance.
mathematical_spec: Result R=(scenario_hash,revision,build,hardware,software,metrics,raw_samples,timestamps); schema version is explicit and every derived metric references sufficient raw counts or samples for recomputation.
implementation_prompt: Design a versioned JSON result artifact containing scenario identity, revision, build flags, hardware/software fingerprints, metrics, raw samples or counts, and timestamps.

objective: Capture hardware and software environment fingerprints.
mathematical_spec: Fingerprint F=H(cpu,gpu,driver,os,compiler,backend,library_versions,build_flags,power_mode); comparisons are valid only within a declared compatibility relation on F.
implementation_prompt: Collect normalized environment metadata needed to explain performance variance, including device identity, clocks or power mode when available, compiler, backend, driver, and build configuration.

objective: Define reproducible performance baseline storage.
mathematical_spec: For key K=(scenario_hash,compatible_fingerprint), baseline stores robust center m and dispersion d from accepted runs plus source revisions; updates are append-auditable.
implementation_prompt: Specify baseline records keyed by scenario and compatible environment, retaining historical samples, revision provenance, robust center, dispersion, and schema version.

objective: Compute statistically robust performance deltas against baselines.
mathematical_spec: Relative delta D=(m_new-m_base)/m_base; uncertainty is estimated from repeated samples and a regression is actionable only when both effect-size and confidence criteria are met.
implementation_prompt: Implement comparison logic for throughput, TTFT, latency, acceptance, and memory using repeated samples, robust summaries, effect-size thresholds, and confidence intervals.

objective: Define CI correctness gates for Tree-Draft tests.
mathematical_spec: Correctness gate G_corr=AND(test_pass,determinism_pass,equivalence_pass,sanitizer_required_pass); any required component false fails the gate.
implementation_prompt: Specify CI-required correctness jobs and gate composition for deterministic equivalence, integration coverage, and supported sanitizer runs, with clear platform exceptions.

objective: Define CI performance regression gates.
mathematical_spec: For protected metrics, fail when signed regression exceeds metric threshold tau and confidence criterion c; improvement directions are metric-specific, e.g. throughput higher is better while latency and memory lower are better.
implementation_prompt: Create configurable CI regression rules for tokens per second, TTFT, p95 latency, and peak memory with direction-aware thresholds and statistical confidence requirements.

objective: Define CI tree-quality gates for acceptance efficiency.
mathematical_spec: Gate on acceptance metrics A_tok, E[D], and V relative to matched baselines; fail only when degradation exceeds configured practical and statistical thresholds.
implementation_prompt: Add regression checks for speculative acceptance rate, accepted depth, and committed tokens per target invocation so speedups are not maintained by hidden quality regressions.

objective: Define benchmark artifact retention and failure capture.
mathematical_spec: Each CI run maps to immutable artifact set A keyed by run ID and revision; failed gates must retain scenario, raw results, environment fingerprint, logs, and comparator output.
implementation_prompt: Specify artifact names, retention classes, compression, and mandatory failure bundles so any CI regression can be reproduced and audited from captured inputs and measurements.

objective: Attribute regressions to scenario, environment, or code changes.
mathematical_spec: Given result delta and fingerprints, classify attribution evidence from changes in scenario hash, environment fingerprint, build flags, or revision range; ambiguous cases remain explicitly unresolved.
implementation_prompt: Implement a deterministic regression-attribution report that first detects scenario or environment drift, then identifies the code revision interval and relevant changed components without inventing causality.

objective: Define a performance bisect harness for reproducible regression localization.
mathematical_spec: Given known-good g and known-bad b under fixed scenario and compatible environment, binary search evaluates midpoint revisions until the first regressing revision interval is isolated, treating inconclusive measurements as retry states.
implementation_prompt: Specify a revision-bisect runner that rebuilds matched configurations, executes the same benchmark scenario, applies the performance gate, retries inconclusive samples, and records each decision.

objective: Generate a human-readable benchmark comparison report from machine artifacts.
mathematical_spec: For each metric k, report baseline b_k, candidate c_k, relative delta (c_k-b_k)/b_k, uncertainty, sample count, and gate status using the exact stored comparator outputs.
implementation_prompt: Create a deterministic report renderer for benchmark artifacts showing scenario identity, environment compatibility, primary metrics, deltas, confidence, and gate decisions without recomputing hidden values.

objective: Define CI scheduling tiers for fast, nightly, and hardware-specific coverage.
mathematical_spec: Partition test set T into tiers T_fast subseteq T_nightly and hardware sets T_h; every required invariant maps to at least one tier, with documented maximum resource budgets per tier.
implementation_prompt: Map correctness, fuzz, sanitizer, GPU-check, and performance workloads onto pull-request, nightly, and dedicated-hardware schedules with explicit runtime and resource budgets.

objective: Validate Pilar H benchmark and test coverage as a release-readiness matrix.
mathematical_spec: Let requirements R map to evidence E; readiness requires every mandatory r in R to have at least one passing, current evidence item e in E whose scenario and environment scope covers r.
implementation_prompt: Build a release-readiness manifest that maps throughput, latency, acceptance, memory, determinism, statistical correctness, integration, fuzz, sanitizer, CI, artifacts, and attribution requirements to concrete passing evidence.
